title: AI advocates fear New York's moratorium on new data centers could embolden Democrats to enact more state restrictions and seize on the issue in the midterms (Politico)
summary: Politico: AI advocates fear New York's moratorium on new data centers could embolden Democrats to enact more state restrictions and seize on the issue in the midterms — New York's moratorium on data centers could serve as an opening salvo for leaders in other states looking to rein in tech infrastructure …
